evidence.description: Security video nearby appeared to show a person walking away from the van.
Video shows the suspect riding a bike into one office, taking cash from a cash box, sawing into a safe, then sawing through a wall into the restaurant.
Van stolen from a nearby business and driven through a garage door, causing more than $70,000 in damage.
E-bike left behind, wrapped in cloth and other material to hide its outline.
Stolen van found the next morning in northeast Rochester with a black jacket on the front seat.
Officer responded to an alarm and saw a motion light come on inside.
Officer saw a masked, gloved person in dark clothing carrying a bag, who ran back inside.
A witness account was recorded; its content is not included in the evidence text.
The officer noted camera coverage; specifics are not given.
